value.rationale: A sharp dichotomy for size efficiency in a natural exact-multiplicity-one additive difference construction. It distinguishes uniqueness from global coverage and coverage from controlled witness height, supplies explicit counterexamples at arbitrarily long gaps, and produces polynomially sparse perfect-covering positive pairs for every complementary growth exponent. The invariant and iff condition are motivated by difference representation height, rather than a narrow arbitrary slice.
